Table of Contents • Introduction • Power Plant Development Projects • Status of Proposed U.S. Nameplate Capacity • Proposed Generating Capacity Regional Breakout • Electric Transmission Projects • Status of Proposed AC Electric Transmission Projects • Status of Proposed DC Electric Transmission Projects • Natural Gas (NG) Pipeline Projects • Status of Proposed NG Pipeline Projects • Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Projects • Status of Proposed LNG Projects • Fuel Stockpiles • Proposed U.S. Data Centers • Generating Capacity Regional Breakout 3 Introduction • This report provides a perspective on energy infrastructure in the continental United States under development as of December 31, 2025, focusing on projects making significant progress toward achieving commercial operation • The states of the projects vary from “Announced” to “Under Construction” • The states of “Announced” or “Early Development” are not necessarily strong indicators of commitment of major capital and human resources; development through operational capacity additions
